Black & White series · DRV

Dragon Vault

Released October 5, 2012 · 21 cards

Expanded

Dragon Vault is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Black & White series, released in English on October 5, 2012. Its main set has 20 cards, plus 1 secret rare numbered beyond the set (21 in total). It includes 18 Pokémon, 3 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

17 illustrators worked on Dragon Vault. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (3), Ryo Ueda (3), Akira Komayama (1), BERUBURI (1), Eske Yoshinob (1), Hajime Kusajima (1), Hideaki Hakozaki (1), Kagemaru Himeno (1).
